data.action: 端坐在复古木椅前，优雅执白瓷茶壶为对面斟茶，眉眼含笑温和
data.description: 罗德岛阳光温和的欧式贵宾茶室内，白瓷茶具散发着大吉岭红茶的清香。薇薇安娜端坐在古典木椅前，双手稳稳提起精致的瓷质茶壶，将金红色的红茶注入眼前的茶杯中，金鹿巨角在室内绿植掩映下显得格外温柔——「博士，请用茶。在忙碌的事务之余，偶尔也让身心沉浸在茶香与宁静中吧。」
data.lighting: 午后侧窗透光照在壶嘴、茶流与蓝丝绒上，远处有一盏暖壁灯
data.location: 罗德岛欧式贵宾会客茶室
data.promptProse: Viviana sits at the near end of the Rhodes Island guest salon in a fitted peacock-blue velvet jacket over an ivory blouse. The camera looks across a round table draped in linen. She tips a white porcelain teapot, steadying its lid with her free fingers as an unbroken thread of amber tea falls into the cup on its saucer. Fir-green fern leaves frame the far wall and a small wall lamp lights a panel of dark wood. Afternoon light filtered through the side window catches the gold piping on her cuff and the porcelain rim, with her face, hands and the stream of tea all visible.
data.title: 薇薇安娜 · 罗德岛茶室的温茶叙话
data.animaCaption: Seated at the linen-draped salon table, she steadies the white porcelain teapot with both hands and pours a slender amber stream of tea into the cup. Afternoon window light catches the gold piping on her peacock-blue velvet cuff while a fern and warm wall lamp recede behind her.
